mapper.html: Thanks for contacting us. We received request {{1.headers.x-request-id}}.
mapper.subject: Request received

notes.body: Receives the inbound request and exposes the request identifier.

sections.Input: Accepts the inbound request body and request identifier from the webhook.
sections.Operator check: Confirm the webhook is selected and available before handoff.
sections.Output: Makes the request body and identifier available to the parser.
sections.Purpose: Starts the customer workflow from the inbound webhook request.

notes.title: MOD-1 Webhook intake

notes.body: Parses the submitted JSON body for downstream routing fields.

sections.Input: Receives the webhook body and the configured parsing schema.
sections.Operator check: Confirm the expected JSON fields are present in the sample payload.
sections.Output: Produces parsed lead fields for routing and downstream actions.
sections.Purpose: Converts the inbound body into structured fields for the workflow.

notes.title: MOD-2 JSON parse

notes.body: Branches urgent and routine requests into separate handling paths.

sections.Input: Receives parsed lead fields including the priority value.
sections.Operator check: Confirm both route conditions match the customer priority policy.
sections.Output: Sends urgent and routine leads into their matching branches.
sections.Purpose: Chooses the correct handling path for each parsed lead.

notes.title: MOD-3 Router

notes.body: Stores urgent requests in the configured datastore.

sections.Input: Receives urgent lead identifiers, email, priority, and status fields.
sections.Operator check: Confirm the destination data store exists and accepts the mapped fields.
sections.Output: Creates or preserves the urgent lead record for operations follow-up.
sections.Purpose: Stores urgent lead details in the customer-owned data store.

notes.title: MOD-4 Datastore write

notes.body: Posts an urgent request summary to the operations channel.

sections.Input: Receives the stored urgent lead summary and contact fields.
sections.Operator check: Confirm the operations channel and account are selected in Make.
sections.Output: Posts a concise urgent lead notification to the operations channel.
sections.Purpose: Alerts the operations team when an urgent lead needs review.

notes.title: MOD-5 Slack alert

notes.body: Sends a routine acknowledgement email to the requester.

sections.Input: Receives the routine lead email address and acknowledgement content.
sections.Operator check: Confirm the sender account and email template are ready.
sections.Output: Sends the requester an acknowledgement for the received request.
sections.Purpose: Confirms receipt for routine leads without operations escalation.

notes.title: MOD-6 Email acknowledgement

notes.body: Reports datastore write failures without stopping the scenario.

sections.Input: Receives the failed datastore write context and request identifier.
sections.Operator check: Confirm the alert destination is monitored by operations.
sections.Output: Posts a failure notice while allowing controlled recovery behavior.
sections.Purpose: Notifies operations when urgent lead storage needs review.

notes.title: MOD-7 Error notification

notes.body: Passes the webhook body into the parser.

sections.Data contract: The parser receives the request body and request identifier.
sections.Failure signal: A missing request body should pause activation review.
sections.Handoff: Moves the inbound webhook payload into the parser step.

notes.title: CONN-1-2 Intake to parser

notes.body: Passes parsed fields into the router.

sections.Data contract: The router receives parsed priority and contact fields.
sections.Failure signal: Missing priority should block route handoff review.
sections.Handoff: Moves parsed lead fields into the routing step.

notes.title: CONN-2-3 Parser to router

notes.body: Sends urgent requests into the datastore path.

sections.Data contract: The datastore receives request identity, email, priority, and status.
sections.Failure signal: Missing request identity should stop the storage handoff.
sections.Handoff: Moves urgent routed leads into the datastore write step.

notes.title: CONN-3-4 Router to urgent store

notes.body: Posts a notification after the urgent request is stored.

sections.Data contract: The notification receives the urgent lead summary after storage.
sections.Failure signal: Missing contact summary should stop notification handoff.
sections.Handoff: Moves stored urgent lead context into the operations alert.

notes.title: CONN-4-5 Store to Slack

notes.body: Routes datastore failures into the error notification branch.

sections.Data contract: The alert receives the failed write context and request identifier.
sections.Failure signal: Missing failure context should stop error notification handoff.
sections.Handoff: Moves datastore write failures into the operations alert branch.

notes.title: CONN-4-7 Store to error notification

notes.body: Sends routine requests into the acknowledgement email path.

sections.Data contract: The email step receives recipient address and acknowledgement content.
sections.Failure signal: Missing recipient address should stop email handoff.
sections.Handoff: Moves routine routed leads into the acknowledgement email step.

notes.title: CONN-3-6 Router to routine email
